title: gitbroker receipt v1
description: What the poller commits back as receipts/<ulid>.json for EVERY envelope (fired, refused, failed, unparseable). THICK on purpose: git collapses CHANNEL into CALL, so the receipt must carry the whole afferent leg — status, allowlisted headers, capped body + full-body digest, latency — plus the X-8-Witness reafference, so the far end learns the outcome from the receipt alone. It is a PUBLIC artifact: response headers are allowlisted (Content-Type, Content-Length, X-8-*) and a slot-authenticated call publishes only the body's sha256 unless the policy opts in.

contract.description: trace.Version — the wire contract version the poller speaks.

decision.description: The authoritative side's verdict. fired=false means the CALL never left this machine.

policy.description: Which gate decided: validate | expiry | auth-slot | closed | <policy name>.

egress.description: The outbound gate applied to this receipt (absent = default: capped body for plain calls, allowlisted headers, digest-only for auth_slot calls).

body.description: Include the capped body for calls WITHOUT an auth_slot.

authenticated_body.description: Explicit opt-in: include the body of a slot-authenticated call. Default false = body_len + body_digest only.

call.description: Echo of what was fired. Headers are deliberately absent — after auth_slot resolution they hold a credential.

status.description: HTTP status of the afferent leg (as the witness returned it).

latency_ms.description: Measured at the poller, witness round-trip included.

body_len.description: Full body length before the cap.

body_digest.description: sha256 hex of the FULL body — verifiable even when truncated.

body.description: Response body, capped at the poller's MaxBody. ABSENT for a slot-authenticated call unless the policy sets egress.authenticated_body (the digest is always present).

headers.description: ALLOWLISTED response headers only, first value each: Content-Type, Content-Length, X-8-*. Set-Cookie, WWW-Authenticate and every other server header are never echoed.

authenticated.description: True when the CALL was fired with a host-side auth_slot credential (so body is digest-only by default).

witness.description: The reafference the 8 collector stamped on the response: proof the act was seen.

line.description: X-8-Witness, e.g. 'seen · act #244176 · call · 0ms · GET / · by far-end'.

error.description: Set when the envelope was unreadable/unparseable or the fire failed.
